$schema_note: Machine-readable skill index for the MedRag synthesizer. The synthesizer ALWAYS composes: base (evidence discipline) + one writing-style skill + humanizer. Loader: backend/src/lib/skills.py (load_skill / detect_writing_mode / build_synthesis_prompt).

concise-clinical.trigger: default; direct short answers (what dose / does X work / what is the risk)

structured-review.trigger: review / summarize / map the evidence on X; multi-part clinical topics

patient-facing.trigger: lay audiences: 'I have...', 'for me', 'should I', plain-language asks

evidence-critique.trigger: 'how strong is the evidence', 'are findings consistent', critical appraisal

humanizer.note: always applied as the final prose pass on every answer
